critiques.description: One entry per option card you were given. Do not skip any.

weakest_assumption.description: One sentence. The load-bearing belief most likely to be false.

likely_failure_mode.description: One sentence. Concretely, how this breaks in practice.

hidden_cost.description: One sentence. The cost its advocates are not counting.

best_fix.description: One sentence. The cheapest change that most reduces the risk.

overall_ranking.description: Option IDs from best to worst, by your judgement. Include every option.

decision_crux.description: The single question whose answer decides between the top options. One or two sentences.
